questions.question: Which Indian Army officer won the UN Secretary-General’s Award 2025 for gender-inclusive peacekeeping?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Major Swathi Shantha Kumar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Indian Army officer Major Swathi Shantha Kumar__ won the __UN Secretary-General’s Award 2025__ in the Gender Category for her project “Equal Partners, Lasting Peace”.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Major Swathi led the Indian Engagement Team__ under the __UN Mission in South Sudan__.**
 
• **Her leadership promoted __women’s deployment and integration__ in peacekeeping operations.**
 
• **Enabled __effective patrols, community outreach,__ and safer access to conflict-affected areas.**
 
• **Project titled __“Equal Partners, Lasting Peace”__ was selected among nominations from all UN peacekeeping missions worldwide.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **UN Secretary-General’s Award**__ – Recognizes outstanding peacekeepers promoting inclusivity and effectiveness.
 
• __**Gender-inclusive Peacekeeping**__ – Focuses on integration of women to enhance operational efficiency and community trust.
 
• __**Indian Engagement Team**__ – India contributes personnel to UN peacekeeping missions globally.
 
• __**Significance**__ – First-time international recognition for India in gender-focused peacekeeping initiatives.

questions.question: _______________ won the 2025 UNESCO Award of Merit for its cultural heritage conservation efforts.

options.text: Our Lady of Grace Cathedral, Vasai

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is __Our Lady of Grace Cathedral, Vasai.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• The **Our Lady of Grace Cathedral** in **Vasai, Maharashtra** received the **2025 UNESCO Award of Merit** for cultural heritage conservation.
 
• The recognition was given under the **UNESCO Asia-Pacific Awards for Cultural Heritage Conservation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Highlights__** 

 
• The cathedral is a **475-year-old structure** located in **Papdy village, Vasai.**
 
• Originally built in the **16th century during the Portuguese colonial period**.
 
• Architectural style reflects **Portuguese Baroque and Gothic influences**, adapted to local climatic conditions.
 
• The restoration was a **community-led initiative** involving local residents, church authorities, conservation experts, and historians.
 
• Conservation work used **traditional materials like lime mortar** to maintain structural authenticity.

**Significance:**

 
• The award highlights the importance of **community participation in heritage preservation**.
 
• It brings international recognition to India’s cultural conservation efforts.
 
• The recognition is expected to boost heritage awareness and tourism in the Vasai region.

questions.question: Project Veer Gatha is a joint initiative of which two Union Ministries to inspire school students with stories of gallantry award winners?

options.text: Ministry of Home Affairs and Ministry of Culture
Ministry of Youth Affairs and Ministry of Home Affairs
Ministry of Education and Ministry of Defence
Ministry of Education and Ministry of Culture

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Education and Ministry of Defence.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Project Veer Gatha 5.0 (2025-26) was recently launched as a collaborative effort to disseminate stories of valor among school students across India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Project Veer Gatha was instituted in 2021 by the Ministry of Defence (MoD) in collaboration with the Ministry of Education (MoE) to foster patriotism and civic values.**
 
• The initiative targets students from **Classes 3 to 12**, encouraging them to create projects like poems, essays, paintings, and multimedia presentations on gallantry award winners.
 
• The 5.0 edition (2025-26) expanded its scope to include **pre-independence warriors** and historical military traditions under the theme "Samarik Parampara."
 
• Project Participation__
 __
 
• Inception - 2021 (as part of Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav)
 
• Veer Gatha 5.0 Participation - Over 1.92 crore students
 
• National Winners - Top 100 students known as "Super 100"
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Gallantry Awards Portal (GAP)__

 __
 
• Significance - The digital platform where stories of bravery are documented; Project Veer Gatha is instituted under this portal.
 
• Objective - To serve as a single-window source for information on all gallantry awardees since independence.
 
 
 
• Super 100 Rewards__
 
 
• Cash Prize - Rs 10,000 per winner.
 
• Recognition - Felicitated jointly by the MoE and MoD in New Delhi and invited to the Republic Day Parade at Kartavya Path.
